source.title: Town of Melbourne Beach FY2027 Final Budget

meta.note: The town’s General Fund for the year that began Oct 1, 2026. The ten departments below add up to $4,704,285 exactly. Every line item, the audit, water, jail and the November 3 bond are on the town’s own site: melbournebeachfl.countycommons.us.
facts: The town tax rate stays at 4.6000 mills, 4.58% above the rolled-back rate of 4.3987.
Town voters decide a $5.0 million stormwater and road bond on November 3, 2026 (facts on the town site; no side taken).
The 2025 audit found one recommendation and reported $3,520,439 of unassigned General Fund savings.

departments.name: Town Commission and Clerk (Legislative)
departments.what: Five commissioners paid $3,000 a year each, the town clerk and deputy clerk, elections, legal notices, and records software.

departments.name: Town Manager (Executive)
departments.what: The town manager ($124,500, contract) and an assistant, plus $78,000 of professional services: $33,000 for grant writing and $45,000 for a non-ad valorem (special assessment) study (PDF p.

departments.name: Finance
departments.what: The finance manager and finance clerk, the annual audit ($35,000), a federal single audit ($3,500), and an actuarial report (PDF p.

departments.name: Town Attorney (Legal)
departments.what: The town attorney and code enforcement legal work.

departments.name: General Services (town hall, insurance, streetlights)
departments.what: What it costs to run the town’s buildings: insurance ($151,417 across liability, flood, property, auto and cyber), phones and internet, streetlights, utilities, and $110,000 of capital — mostly a state-required elevator repair ($100,000, PDF p.

departments.name: Police
departments.what: The Melbourne Beach Police Department: a chief, a deputy chief, two sergeants, two corporals, six officers (one is the school resource officer, paid back by the School Board) and an assistant (PDF p.

departments.name: Fire
departments.what: The Melbourne Beach Volunteer Fire Department: a paid chief and three paid captains, plus about 36 volunteers who share $59,200 in stipends (PDF pp.

departments.name: Code Enforcement
departments.what: One code officer, plus a $15,000 software line.

departments.name: Public Works
departments.what: A director, a foreman, two maintenance workers and a groundskeeper who keep up streets, parks, buildings and trees.
